atlas_home_region_card.compact: Heavy alternative where metal riffs mutate through hip-hop, funk, prog, and 1990s angst.

region_scene_page.compact: This road follows heavy music after alternative rock broke the gates, from art-metal gravity to nu-metal's bounce and rap-metal's attack.
region_scene_page.standard: This road follows heavy music after alternative rock broke the gates, from art-metal gravity to nu-metal's bounce and rap-metal's attack. Korn's Falling Away from Me, Limp Bizkit's My Way, Slipknot's Duality, and System of a Down's B.Y.O.B. give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
region_scene_page.deep: This road follows heavy music after alternative rock broke the gates, from art-metal gravity to nu-metal's bounce and rap-metal's attack. The center is not classic metal purity; it is cross-genre impact, groove, and emotional immediacy. Korn's Falling Away from Me, Limp Bizkit's My Way, Slipknot's Duality, and System of a Down's B.Y.O.B. give the scene its high-recognition landmarks. From there, the examples move from quick recognition toward medium and deeper scene signals.
